title.narrative: Réponse multisectorielle d’eau, d’hygiène, d’assainissement et de protection de l'enfant pour sauver la vie des réfugiés soudanais et des retournes tchadiens et des communautés hôtes de l’est du Tchad

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide child protection and water, sanitation and hygiene assistance to returnees, refugees and host community members in Ouaddai, Sila and Wadi Fira. This UNICEF project provides protection services to children, drills 13 boreholes to provide access to fresh water, constructs emergency latrines and showers, distributes WASH kits, and provides access to water treatment and hand-washing kits. The water, sanitation and hygiene component of this project provides humanitarian assistance to 36,000 people, including 7,500 women, 6,900 men, 21,600 children, and including 4,700 persons with disabilities. The child protection component provides humanitarian assistance to 18,000 people, including 1,500 women, 1,500 men and 15,000 children, and including 2,700 persons with disabilities.
